easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel
